Home / Records office

Records office

Validation and correspondence for partner records

Contact and hours

Records Office, Room 112, Oskerry City Hall
1200 Canal Row, Oskerry, IL 62117

Telephone: (847) 555-0137

Office hours: Mon–Thu, 9 a.m.–4 p.m.

Email: vendors@lakefront-vn.example

Written inquiries are answered within three business days. Counter service is first come, first served.

What the office validates

  • Registration submissions (Form PR-2) and any corrections returned to applicants
  • Company contact details supplied during registration
  • Certification documents lodged by credentialed partners
  • Remittance details before payment instructions are activated

Validation is synchronous during office hours. Submissions arriving outside office hours are queued for the next business day.
